# Restore Instructions

## Web
```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

## Android TV
1. Open the `./tv` folder in Android Studio
2. Build the project:
```bash
cd tv
./gradlew build
```

## Environment Setup
1. Copy `.env.example` to `.env`
2. Fill in your Supabase keys and other environment variables.
